performance.verdict: CPL collapse is real and worsening; 5 overdue milestones block the scoreboard.

findings.text: CPL rose 83.46% in 7d on flat spend (+1.22%); last 3 days averaged 1 lead/day vs 3.67 prior 3 days — confirmed deterioration, not noise.
Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07), sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14), and dashboard (due 2026-08-31) all overdue — August scoreboard is untrusted.
102 GHL opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments logged — leads arriving but pipeline shows no conversion; likely an intake/tagging gap, not an ads problem.
Spend has been flat (~$26/day) while leads fell from a 4–8/day peak (Aug 23–31) to 0–1/day (Sep 8–10) — classic creative fatigue pattern on a single Meta channel.
GBP actions dropped 50% in 7d; last 4 days show 0 GBP actions, suggesting organic/local visibility is also contracting alongside paid decline.

suggestions.text: Introduce at least 1 new creative into BWS Retargeting campaign; CPL up 83% on flat spend is probable fatigue.
suggestions.monday_update: CPL jumped 83.46% over the last 7 days while daily spend held flat at ~$26/day, and leads dropped from a peak of 6–8/day in late August to 0–1/day Sep 8–10. Push at least one new creative variant into the BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting campaign (top campaign, $375.24 of 28-day spend). Success check: CPL returns below the 28-day baseline of $7.46 within 7 days of the new creative going live. Re-check by 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Close the intake leak: reconcile 102 GHL opps, 0 wins, 0 appointments — tag and route correctly before next lead volume push.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 102 opportunities created over 28 days with 0 won and 0 appointments logged, meaning no lead-to-chair journey is being tracked — directly breaking the client's stated scoreboard (leads → schedule → show → patient). The dashboard milestone was due 2026-08-31 and is overdue. Audit opportunity stages, fix appointment tagging, and confirm the OpenDental sync is writing back correctly. Success check: at least 1 won opportunity and appointment confirmed in GHL by 2026-09-18, with dashboard visible to Sohib.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions for 3 more days before acting; 0 actions Sep 7–10 may reflect a data lag, not a true drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 50% week-over-week and have logged 0 for the last 4 days in the series (Sep 7–10). This could be a reporting lag in the GBP API rather than a real visibility drop. Monitor through 2026-09-14; if actions remain at 0, escalate to the SEO/GBP team for a profile audit. No budget action until confirmed.
